using System; using System.Collections.Generic; namespace Demo { /// <summary>A demo class.</summary> /// <remarks>More.</remarks> public class Box<T> where T : class { private readonly T value; public const int Max = 42; public Box(T value) => this.value = value; public string Describe(int count = 0) { var verbatim = @"raw ""string"" here"; var interpolated = $"value={value} count={count}"; var numbers = 0x1f + 0b1010 + 1.5e-3; var list = new List<string> { "a", "b" }; if (count > 0 && list.Count != 0) { return $"{verbatim} {interpolated} {numbers}"; } return "hello, " + value; } } interface IGreet { void Greet(); } }
